card.summary: 'YouDebrid premium link generator is free and will stay always free', with the cap in the FAQ: 'you may be able to debrid about 8 files per day.'

free_tier.stated: 'YouDebrid premium link generator is free and will stay always free', with the cap in the FAQ: 'you may be able to debrid about 8 files per day.'

per_object_cap.stated: 'We don't have irritating file size limitations'

retention.stated: 'Auto-shred technology permanently destroys your premium links after download completion'

egress.terms: 'Download your link files as fast as you can, without restrictions!'

record.interface_detail: Web form with a 'Get Premium Link' button; no API, CLI or plugin documented.
record.chaining: Identical role to the other anonymous generators; no reason to prefer it except when another in the family is rate-limiting the same IP.
record.limits_note: 'more than +100 cloud file hosting tools' with no list on the home page.
record.binding_note: Eight files a day, with IP-locked links, is the ceiling; nothing else is documented that could bind first.

identity_cost.detail: No account; links are bound to the requesting IP ('Biometric IP-lock system ensures only your device can access the generated premium link').

record.reliability_note: The marketing language ('military-grade 256-bit', 'biometric IP-lock') describes an IP check; no status page and no host list on the home page.
record.confidence_note: Cap and no-account flow are vendor-stated and read; enforcement untested.

evidence.proved: 'you may be able to debrid about 8 files per day', 'free and will stay always free', '+100 cloud file hosting tools', the IP lock

record.notes: Third member of the 8-a-day template family (AnyDebrid, MaxDebrid, MegaDownloader). The site is the largest build of the four (73,254 bytes), which is consistent with a shared template carrying more article content rather than a different backend.
